ccs_lab.name: OpenEvo CCS Lab
ccs_lab.intro: Our earlier work treated evolutionary and behavioral science as an interdisciplinary lens for curriculum design: causal mapping, cooperation across textbooks, the Community Science Lab model. The OpenEvo CCS Lab extends that same instinct computationally. We represent curricula themselves (standards, learning progressions, competency frameworks) as structured, comparable knowledge graphs, so researchers and policymakers can see where interdisciplinary concepts cohere across grade bands and subjects, and where they don't.
ccs_lab.fair_commitment: The lab is committed to FAIR (findable, accessible, interoperable, reusable) data and FAIR theory in curriculum studies research: concepts, standards, and literature records carry persistent identifiers and stated licenses, and theoretical claims are specified as citable, versioned records, following Van Lissa et al. (2026).

flagship.name: OpenEvo ConceptBase (OECB)
flagship.description: The semantic backbone of the lab: a shared, version-controlled ontology and controlled vocabularies (profiled against SKOS, IEEE LOM, schema.org, and 1EdTech CASE) that let independently maintained curriculum models describe their content in a common, interoperable language — without imposing a single 'correct' curriculum.

projects.name: Computational curriculum analysis of German Lehrplan documents
projects.description: Natural Language Processing (NLP) analysis of how concepts are distributed across German state curricula, for the forthcoming book Hanisch (in press), Evolutionäre Anthropologie als fächerübergreifender Biologieunterricht (Springer).

projects.name: OpenLPM
projects.description: A free, open platform for researchers, teachers, and curriculum policy makers to build learning progressions together, and keep improving them as classroom experience comes in. Currently in limited beta testing with selected partners.

projects.name: NetLogo models
projects.description: A collection of 15 agent-based simulation models for teaching evolution, cooperation, and sustainability, with a working space for learning progression strands built around them.
